home.clientsBody: From independent creators to luxury houses, the studio works for fashion, beauty and accessories brands, including Jean Paul Gaultier, Coperni, Carven, The Kooples, Diptyque, Rimowa and John Lobb.

cyclorama.title: Cyclorama
cyclorama.body: A 32 m² two-sided cyclo for photo and video on an infinite white backdrop, with natural light through blackout skydomes. By the day or the week, free production or with our team: campaigns, editorial, advertising films, packshots and still life.

live.title: Live stage
live.body: Our solution dedicated to on-model shooting. It produces consistent, fast e-commerce content that is reproducible from one session to the next: on-model shoots, e-commerce photo and video, lookbooks and linesheets.

eclipse.title: Eclipse stage
eclipse.body: Designed for small and medium products: shoes, bags, accessories, design objects or beauty. Its built-in turntable allows 360° photo and video, for e-commerce as well as still life.

horizontal.title: Horizontal stage
horizontal.body: Designed for flat-lay packshots: precise, consistent flat lays suited to garments, accessories and product compositions, with automatic image clipping.

vertical.title: Vertical stage
vertical.body: Built for textile packshots on a mannequin: particularly effective for ghost, pinned and standardised e-commerce shots, with automatic image clipping.

postprod.title: Post-production
postprod.body: On-model, ghost, flat, accessories and pinned retouching, high-end and video retouching on request: clipping, background change, color grading, textile cleaning. We also retouch images you didn't shoot with us.

home.seoIntro: E-Do Studio is a 240 m² photo and video studio in Saint-Ouen, on the edge of Paris. Fashion, beauty and accessories brands produce their e-commerce imagery, campaigns and films here: a two-sided cyclorama for free production, four equipped stages for packshots and on-model shoots, and a post-production service. On site: a loading dock, parking, two equipped make-up stations, two fitting rooms and a fully equipped kitchen. Every stage can be booked online, or on quote.

onModelPage.title: On-model photo studio in Paris: the Live stage
onModelPage.intro: The Live stage is E-Do Studio's dedicated on-model shooting solution. Set in our 240 m² photo and video studio in Saint-Ouen, on the edge of Paris, it produces consistent e-commerce content, fast to make and easy to reproduce across sessions.

stage.title: A stage built for on-model shooting
stage.body: The Live stage is where products worn by a model are photographed and filmed. It covers three uses: on-model shooting, e-commerce photo and video, lookbooks and linesheets. It is designed to keep that content consistent and reproducible from one session to the next, so a new series matches the ones before it.

equipment.title: Live stage equipment
equipment.body: Images are captured with a Canon EOS R body fitted with a motorized 24–105 mm zoom. The motorization works on three axes: height, tilt and zoom. The whole setup is controlled from an iPad app. Lighting is continuous high-CRI LED, which serves photo and video alike. Files are delivered as JPG, PNG, TIFF and RAW for photo, and MP4 and MOV for video.

mannequin.title: On a model or on a ghost mannequin
mannequin.body: “Mannequin photography” covers two practices, and the studio has a stage for each. For a garment worn by a model, it is the Live stage. For textile packshots on a mannequin, without a model, it is the Vertical stage: particularly efficient for ghost, pinned and standardized e-commerce shots, with automatic image clipping.

team.title: With or without a photographer
team.body: You can come with your own crew or without a photographer. The studio provides the stage, the machines, the lighting and the technical operator. A photographer, stylist or model can be provided on request.

studio.title: A 240 m² studio in Saint-Ouen, on the edge of Paris
studio.body: E-Do Studio is located at 69 boulevard Victor Hugo, Saint-Ouen. On site: a loading dock, parking, two equipped make-up stations, two fitting rooms and a fully equipped kitchen. The studio also has a 32 m² two-sided cyclorama for photo and video on an infinite white backdrop, three other stages equipped for packshots, and photo retouching, which you can add to your booking.

rates.title: Live stage rates
rates.body: The Live stage rents for €{{hour}} per hour, €{{half}} per half day and €{{full}} per full day, excluding VAT. These are the rates applied by the online booking flow.

booking.title: Book the Live stage
booking.body: The stage is booked online: pick the stage and your slots, leave your details, and your quote is sent to you by email. For a custom project, write to us from the contact page. Would you rather see the studio first? Visits are free, take about an hour and run Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm.

studioRental.intro: E-Do Studio rents out its photo and video stages in Saint-Ouen, on the edge of Paris. Across 240 m², fashion, beauty and accessories brands have a two-sided cyclorama for free production and four equipped stages for packshots and on-model shoots. Every stage can be booked online, or on quote.

studio.title: A 240 m² studio on the edge of Paris
studio.body: The studio is at 69 boulevard Victor Hugo, Saint-Ouen, in the Victor Hugo business park (building 6.7). Come by metro, line 13 to Garibaldi or line 14 to Mairie de Saint-Ouen, or by car: access is direct and parking is on site. A 3.5 m by 4.5 m high loading dock makes it easy to bring in equipment and collections. For your crew, the studio has two equipped make-up stations, two fitting rooms and a fully equipped kitchen.

cyclorama.title: Hiring the cyclorama
cyclorama.body: The cyclorama is a 32 m² two-sided cyclo, 6.3 m long, 5.2 m wide and 5 m high, for photo and video on an infinite white backdrop. Blackout skydomes bring in natural light, or shut it out. It can be hired by the day or the week, for free production or with our team, for a campaign, an editorial, an advertising film, packshots or still life. On the technical side, it has a 63 A three-phase Marechal socket, fifteen 16 A sockets, very high-speed Wi-Fi and a built-in sound system. The 5-hour package is {{cyclo}} excl. VAT.

stages.title: Four stages for packshots and on-model shoots
stages.body: The Live stage is our solution dedicated to on-model shooting: consistent, fast e-commerce content that is reproducible from one session to the next, for on-model shoots, e-commerce photo and video, lookbooks and linesheets. It is charged {{live}} excl. VAT per hour. The Eclipse is designed for small and medium products, shoes, bags, accessories, design objects or beauty, with a built-in turntable for 360° photo and video. Both stages are equipped with a Canon EOS R and a motorised 24–105 mm lens, controlled from an iPad app, and continuous High-CRI LED lighting. The Horizontal stage is built for flat-lay packshots, the Vertical for textile packshots on a mannequin, ghost and pinned included; both clip images automatically.

team.title: Free production or with our team
team.body: You can come with your own crew, or without a photographer: the studio provides the stage, the machines, the lighting and the technical operator. A photographer, stylist or model can be provided on request. After the shoot, the studio also offers photo retouching, including for images not shot at our studio.

booking.title: Booking the studio
booking.body: Booking is done online: pick the stage and your time slots, leave your contact details, and the quote reaches you by email. For a custom project, write to us from the contact page. The studio is open Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm, and at weekends on request. You can also visit before booking: the tour is free, takes about an hour and is by appointment.

where.question: Where is the studio?
where.answer: At 69 boulevard Victor Hugo, 93400 Saint-Ouen, on the edge of Paris, in the Victor Hugo business park (building 6.7). Metro line 13, Garibaldi station, or line 14, Mairie de Saint-Ouen station. Parking is on site.

price.question: How much does it cost to hire the studio?
price.answer: The cyclorama is {{cyclo}} excl. VAT for 5 hours, the Live stage {{live}} excl. VAT per hour. Each stage's rates are shown on its page, and the booking flow builds your quote.

photographer.question: Can we come without a photographer?
photographer.answer: Yes. The studio provides the stage, the machines, the lighting and the technical operator. A photographer, stylist or model can be provided on request.

visit.question: Can we visit the studio before booking?
visit.answer: Yes. The tour is free, takes about an hour and runs Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm. Write to us to set a time.

book.question: How do I book a stage?
book.answer: Online, from the Book page: pick the stage and the time slots, leave your contact details, then “Receive my quote”. For a custom project, write to us from the contact page.
